key_events: Artie and Fizz browsed the Oakhaven Market for defensive gear.
Artie discovered that all viable armor was either too expensive or level-locked.
Artie checked his Leather Wallet but realized his real-world currency was useless.
Artie concluded that standard merchants could not solve his 1 HP fragility.
Artie and Fizz relocated to the Starter Quest Hub.
Fizz identified a tutorial chest meant to teach lockpicking.
Artie acquired a Rusty Iron Dagger from the ground.
Artie prepared to strike the unbreakable lock, hoping his 100% crit rate would bypass its defenses.
Artie struck the tutorial chest lock with his Rusty Iron Dagger.
The lock was destroyed by a 99,999 damage critical hit.
Artie acquired the Cloak of the Cowardly Lion.
Artie equipped the Cloak of the Cowardly Lion.
Guild guards noticed the theft and pursued Artie.
Artie and Fizz fled into an alleyway.
Artie lost his Safe Zone Active status upon entering the crypts.
The Cloak of the Cowardly Lion's flawed stealth caused it to whimper in fear.
Artie aggroed a Level 8 Skeletal Guard.
Artie dodged the Skeletal Guard's attack and threw a loose rock at it.
The rock triggered a 99,999 damage critical hit, instantly shattering the skeleton.
Artie gained 150 XP from the defeated enemy.
The massive overkill damage caused a system error, forcing the skeleton to drop its entire loot table at once.
Artie stowed his Rusty Iron Dagger, eager to farm more skeletons.
Artie used rocks to trigger 99,999 damage critical hits on multiple skeletons.
The overkill damage caused a system error, forcing the skeletons to drop their entire loot tables.
Artie leveled up twice, reaching Level 3.
Artie gained 10 Stat Points and increased his Stamina to 12/12.
Artie cleared the antechamber, leaving it buried in a mountain of loot.
